property_summary: A direct call to C.fallback via calling c with value (by sending to c through c.sendMoney to itself isn't allowed), so instead we assert that performing a payable withdrawAll by owner either reverts and leaves balance/count unchanged, or succeeds and transfers all ETH out — but a different rule than existing: calling withdraw(uint) with value 0 by owner must never change depositsCount and must not change C.balance if it succeeds.
